notes: This is a Lit public-preview patch cohort: @context-action/lit remains 0.1.0 and is reused; @context-action/lit-ui advances to 0.1.1.
The patch fixes hydrateLit adoption of declarative shadow roots that begin with static styles and repairs duplicate client trees.
The existing @context-action/lit 0.1.0 artifact is bound to its original attested commit d18c926d; lit-ui 0.1.1 must be attested at the candidate release commit.
Publication must run lit before lit-ui and bind every artifact to an approved immutable main commit.
lit and @lit/context are peer dependencies; React is an optional peer used only by the bridge, and @lit-labs/ssr peers are optional for ./ssr.
